notes: Redesigned Library and Captions tabs: search, collection chips, clear wide previews, a + button to add at the playhead, and a simple caption list with Use.
Overlapping components get their own rows on the timeline.
Select a component on the video to see it outlined: drag it to move it, drag a corner to resize it, and its settings open in the sidebar.
Click a component on the video or its block on the timeline to edit it in the sidebar: text, timing and style, with changes playing straight away.
New components are centred on the frame, and their dark backing no longer gets clipped.
